Firm Overview

Committed to Assisting the Injured Community Across Northern California Since 2018

Empowering Clients to Restore Their Lives in Oakland and San Francisco

With 80+ years of combined lawyer experience in the workers’ compensation field, our workers' compensation team is properly equipped with the knowledge and experience to handle all your workers’ compensation case. Our attorneys have handled over 1,000 cases throughout Northern California and the Bay Area.

Our law firm strives for dedicated, successful and personalized personal injury and workers' compensation counsel for each and every one of our clients. We are there for our injured clients every step of the way. From a serious auto accident to a construction accident at work, we have more than 34 years of experience at your service.

Protecting Your Rights and Interests

We are deeply committed to improving the lives of our clients who have endured injury. With a track record of successfully litigating thousands of cases, including construction site accidents and products liability claims, we are driven by a passion for justice. Our approach is characterized by vigorous, timely, and cost-effective litigation strategies, coupled with personalized client service. We prioritize accessibility and responsiveness, ensuring that you fully understand your rights and empowering you to secure maximum compensation and recovery for your injuries. Moreover, we remain actively engaged in our community, dedicating countless hours to pro bono legal work and collaborating with organizations such as the West Oakland Western Service Workers Association. 

Empowering You Through Every Step of Your Legal Journey

At Franco Muñoz Law, our commitment to our clients goes beyond legal representation—it's about providing comprehensive support and guidance during challenging times. With a sterling reputation in our community and a steadfast dedication to serving injured individuals, our team offers a spectrum of services aimed at aiding you or your loved one in the aftermath of an injury:

  • Connecting you with the necessary medical care and support networks.
  • Assisting in navigating insurance claims and deciphering essential documentation.
  • Advocating on your behalf in communications with opposing attorneys and insurance entities.
  • Skillfully negotiating for a fair and equitable settlement reflective of your injuries.
  • Conducting thorough investigations to ascertain liability and potential compensation.
  • Vigorously defending your rights and interests both inside and outside the courtroom.
  • Presenting compelling arguments in civil and Workers’ Compensation courts when a settlement proves elusive.

With our team by your side, you can rest assured that your needs and interests are our top priority. 

Every lawyer at our workers' comp law firm focuses on one thing: helping injured and disabled workers throughout Northern California. We are one of the most respected Workers Compensation and Injury Law Firms in Northern California.

Our goal is to make the workers’ compensation claim process as simple as possible, tailoring our legal representation to every client. Our attorneys offer free initial consultations and require no retainer fees from injured workers. We will aggressively pursue insurance companies, employers, and anyone or anything else standing between you and medical treatment for your work injury.

Navigating Workers’ Compensation Can Be Complex: Should I Hire a Lawyer?

When it comes to workers’ compensation claims, the path forward isn’t always clear-cut. While some cases are easily resolved between workers and claims administrators, others can be complex and benefit from legal guidance. 

It’s important to note that consulting an attorney doesn’t come with upfront charges. Instead, a portion of your workers’ compensation benefits will cover their fee. If you opt not to seek legal representation, you can still find assistance from Information and Assistance officers at your local Division of Workers’ Compensation office.

Whether or not you opt for legal representation, it’s essential to understand your rights and obligations. Maintain open lines of communication with your employer and claims administrator, and feel empowered to seek clarification when needed. While local Information and Assistance (I&A) officers offer valuable assistance, their scope of representation pales in comparison to that of a dedicated lawyer. That’s why securing the services of a California workers’ compensation attorney at the earliest opportunity is paramount.

Did you know?

  • For recorded assistance, dial 1-800-736-7401 or reach out to the Information and Assistance Unit.
  • Remember, there's no obligation to accept offers from claims administrators. You have the right to negotiate. If agreement proves elusive, a workers’ compensation judge can step in to adjudicate. The judge will determine the benefits you’re entitled to, issuing a written decision known as a Findings and Award.
  • Seeking legal counsel can streamline the process. Attorneys specializing in representing injured workers are termed applicants’ attorneys. Importantly, they don’t charge you directly. Instead, a portion of your workers’ compensation benefits will cover their fee.

How We Will Handle Your Case
At our firm, we are committed to obtaining the most favorable results possible for our clients. The Franco Muñoz Law Firm Legal Team has effectively handled thousands of cases with injured workers, resulting in maximum settlements in their workers' compensation claims. Our law office will aggressively pursue the benefits that every victim of work-related injury in California is entitled to. We will handle all of the details that comprise the claims process, including the following:

  • you come to us or we will come to you, if necessary
  • we will thoroughly investigate the facts of the case
  • submit insurance claims and collect temporary disability benefits expeditiously
  • obtain proper medical treatment for you
  • obtain a neutral physician's opinion to determine a true diagnosis to collect maximum permanent disability benefits.

To get the legal help you need following an injury, whether your injury is from a specific incident, repetitive trauma, or occupational exposure, or to seek death benefits from the death of a loved one, contact our firm for a free consultation with our attorney.
